description: Musical transmission between generations in the context of spiritual practice is a hallmark of
music education in India. Students explore the challenges local educators face when bringing folk
and ritual traditions into an urban folk school setting in Assam. Students experience connections
between music and spirituality first-hand as they learn to perform songs and dances from culture
bearers who introduce them to these participatory traditions in intergenerational environments.
Open to students in all majors. Offered periodically during January term.
fullname: Intergenerational Music Learning in Northeast India (study abroad)
